user_journeys.name: Writing with AI Assistance
steps: 1. User creates new note via NoteSidebar or NoteEditor empty state
2. NoteEditor initializes with empty BlockNote schema
3. User types '/' to open slash command menu
4. User selects AI Magic or specific command
5. executeAICommand called with context extraction
6. Context mode determines text/blocks above cursor
7. generateNoteContent calls AI service via ProviderService
8. AI response parsed to BlockNote blocks
9. AIInsertionDialog shown for replace/append/above selection
10. Blocks inserted into editor
11. Debounced auto-save persists to Dexie
12. Optional file sync exports to markdown
potential_issues: Context extraction fails for complex block structures
AI response parsing fails for non-standard markdown
Block insertion fails with ProseMirror errors on corrupted blocks
Auto-save debounce may lose edits on rapid changes

user_journeys.name: Using Slash Commands
steps: 1. User types '/' in editor
2. BlockNote suggestion menu triggers
3. getCustomSlashMenuItems called with editor instance
4. Menu items filtered by query
5. User selects command or custom command
6. Command handler executes
7. For simple commands: block inserted directly
8. For complex commands: PromptRefinementDialog shown for variables
9. executeAICommand called with final prompt
10. AI content generated and inserted as blocks
potential_issues: 50+ `as any` casts in command implementations may cause runtime errors
Custom command prompt variables may not match expected format
Command execution may time out without user feedback

user_journeys.name: Organizing Notes
steps: 1. User views note list in NoteSidebar
2. User searches with debounced search input
3. User filters by favorites or tags
4. User creates new note or selects existing
5. Note loaded from Dexie via useNoteStore
6. Note displayed in NoteEditor
7. User can favorite, move, or delete note
8. Changes persist to Dexie
9. Optional: Export to markdown via file sync
10. Optional: Index for RAG in Knowledge workspace
potential_issues: Note hierarchy may not be fully implemented
Tag filtering UI may be incomplete
File sync may fail for large notes

user_journeys.name: AI Chat Integration
steps: 1. User opens chat panel (UnifiedChatPanel)
2. Chat runs in 'notes' workspace context
3. User selects text in NoteEditor
4. AI chat can reference selected text
5. Chat responses can be inserted into note
6. Thread management via ThreadManager
7. Conversations persisted via useConversationStore
potential_issues: Chat context may not properly include note content
Chat-to-note insertion may fail for complex content
